workflow.critical: Communicate in {communication_language}. Never invent results. Browser VISIBLE (headed) unless the user explicitly asked for headless this session.

step.action: If config worktree_isolation is not false: follow Phase A of {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/rules/worktree-isolation.md — create branch + git worktree, work only inside it (switch app port per Phase A step 6). Whole command runs inside it
Confirm {output_folder}/EXECUTION-GUIDE.md exists and has no TODO values; else tell the user to run /aiqa-setup and stop
Test file = command argument; if none, list files in {output_folder}/test-cases/ with status from INDEX.md and ask. If argument is --summary go to step 5
Browser mode: visible by default. Ask nothing unless config show_browser is false or user said headless
Write the results file after EACH case. Resume if a results file exists
Run the "Review checklist" in execute-tests.prompt.md over the results file, screenshots and bug files; fix issues (re-run doubtful cases); max 2 rounds. No app changes

step.output: Pass / Fail / Blocked / Not Run counts · Blocked reasons · bugs created (ID, severity, title) · review result (found / fixed / open). Pass-rate vs {min_pass_rate}%. Then the final line (Next Step is : <next command>).

step.action: Run the "Final session variant" in execute-tests.prompt.md: restore check with read-only queries, then write test-results/SUMMARY.md from templates/SUMMARY.template.md

After the review pass: follow Phase B (stop app, reset port to the base value, verify, commit on the sub-branch) and Phase C of {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/rules/worktree-isolation.md. Ask the user to commit/push/merge to the base branch and remove the sub-branch; never do it unasked
step.output: The LAST line of the response is: (Next Step is : <next command>) — see "Next-step line" in the rule file. Nothing after it
